cases.title: Identity to approved, permission-filtered knowledge
cases.historical_scope: Actual local identity, durable approval and publication into permission-filtered retrieval.
limitations: Two public English pages and one clean OCR derivative; no general OCR or answer-quality score.
Scripted service approval does not establish human or owner review; local administration remains trusted.
This audit does not repeat any identity, model, vector, OCR, approval or recovery experiment.

cases.title: Read-only access and explicit retry boundaries
cases.historical_scope: Actual local MCP read-only failure injection with finite retries and preserved audit effects.
limitations: Authored fictional work orders and trusted launcher profiles; no remote identity or external database.
Read retries can add audit effects; no global exactly-once or interruption-of-executing-SQL claim.
Privacy and durable approval are related separate studies, not a connected privacy-to-MCP action system.

cases.title: Local inference measurements and operational limits
cases.historical_scope: One recorded installed-wheel CPU inference experiment with pinned local assets and retained traces.
limitations: Fourteen fixed-order calls on one macOS arm64 host; no quality, p95/p99, capacity or hardware-superiority claim.
Process peak RSS is whole-process lifetime highwater; it is not weights-only memory.
Packaging, fictional costs and administration remain separate studies; this audit runs no inference.
